label: CSV
description: CSV files (RFC 4180: a header row, comma-separated fields, quotes around fields that need them) read as rows of a declared shape, and rows written as a file. The file is streamed both ways; only the rows are values.

parse.description: Read a CSV blob as a list of rows. The header row names the columns; `columns` maps a header name to the field it is read into, and every other column is read into the field of its own name. Each following row becomes one value of `type`, its number and boolean fields coerced from text, judged against the shape. An empty cell of an optional field is absent. A row that does not fit the shape fails the node with its line number.

type.description: the shape of one row; its fields are the columns read

columns.description: header names that are not the field's own name: each key is a header name as the file writes it, each value the field of `type` its column is read into (parse) or written from (write). A column the map does not name is read and written by its own name. Absent: every column by its own name.

write.description: Write rows as a CSV blob: a header row of the shape's fields in declared order, each under the header name `columns` maps to it, else under its own name, then one line per row, quoting what needs it. Answers the new file's handle.

type.description: the shape of one row; its fields are the columns written

columns.description: header names that are not the field's own name: each key is a header name as the file writes it, each value the field of `type` its column is read into (parse) or written from (write). A column the map does not name is read and written by its own name. Absent: every column by its own name.

filename.description: the name the file is offered under when downloaded
